about_the_game:
ATTENTION: The game is done by one person. Bugs and errors are possible! All events and heroes are fictional. Any coincidences with reality are random.

A Zone appeared in North America after an unforeseen catastrophe. Years later, it is a desolated, dangerous place full of deadly new forms of life and anomalies. Stalkers roam the abandoned streets and land in hope of extracting valuable items and miraculous artifacts, while Military squads patrol the Zone, to keep Stalkers out and monsters in. You will need your best skills to travel through on foot or in a vehicle: gun handling and customization, resource gathering and management. Every bullet count, any encounter could be your last. Even a bandage can mean life or death.

Game Features:

  • A unique story-oriented journey through a dark North American post-apocalyptic setting with a mix of action, horror, survival, and RPG elements.

  • The unique atmosphere of loneliness in a dangerous place where anomalies modified the fabric of reality. Things come to life, and time is not always linear.

  • Realistic yet fluid and responsive combat with weapon customization, attachment system and looting.

  • Diverse opponents and allies: stalkers, soldiers, zombies and strange new monsters.

  • Environmental challenges and puzzles.

  • More than 10 huge levels based on real-life North American locations, which supports long range and CQB combats.

  • FPS and TPS modes with easy dynamic change.

content_descriptors.notes: The game features intense scenes of violence, gunfights, and dark post-apocalyptic themes.

short_description: Picnic In The Zone tells a story about survival in the Zone. A vast, desolate place filled with dangerous enemies, deadly anomalies and strange mutated entities. Unveil your epic journey through the Zone as you hopelessly try to find your lost family.
